newsitem.title: FRANCE: French sources reaffirm three pct 98 deficit goal.
newsitem.headline: French sources reaffirm three pct 98 deficit goal.

text.p: French government sources on Thursday confirmed that the government's goal was to reduce the public deficit to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1998.

The sources were speaking following comments to reporters by government spokeswoman Catherine Trautmann, who said the government would seek to get the deficit "as close as possible to three percent" of GDP next year.
They underlined that Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said earlier this week that France's 1998 budget would encompass the goal of a public deficit of three percent.
"The budget is being drawn up on the basis of a deficit of three percent," Strauss-Kahn said last Monday, after unveiling an audit of France's public finances.
